commands.name: ideator
commands.description: Turn raw ingredients (ideas, words, concepts, feelings, references) into concrete directions. Use when the user says "give me ideas about X", "expand on this concept", "what can I do with Y", "synthesize these ideas", "ideate around", "brainstorm about", or provides scattered thoughts and asks to develop them. Works in Spanish and English. Generates 3-4 distinct directions per round, shows connections between ingredients, asks clarifying questions to refine, and stays iterative until the user finds a direction worth pursuing. Can feed into academic-report, projects, or any downstream work. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: import-memory
commands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:llm-wiki-ingest
commands.description: Use this skill for ANY interaction with Leonardo's personal LLM Wiki vault. Triggers include: ingesting a new source file ("Ingesta raw/...", "procesa este PDF para la wiki", "agrega esto a la wiki"), querying the wiki ("¿qué sé sobre X?", "busca en la wiki", "¿qué aprendí de...?"), opening or closing a programming session ("abre sesión", "cierra sesión", "sesión del proyecto X"), wiki maintenance ("actualiza index.md", "revisa duplicados", "qué páginas necesito crear"), or any reference to raw/, wiki/, index.md, log.md, or the vault structure. Always use this skill before touching any file in the vault — it defines all rules, paths, and flows. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning
commands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:page-animator
commands.description: Skill para añadir animaciones a páginas existentes — generadas con v0, Lovable, Bolt, o cualquier AI builder — sin sobrecargarlas ni romper el diseño. Úsala cuando el usuario tenga una página estática lista y quiera que botones, cards, modales, notificaciones, navbars, listas, formularios, o cualquier elemento cobren vida con movimiento. También activa con frases como "anima esto", "agrégale animaciones", "hazlo más dinámico", "que los botones respondan", "que se vea más vivo", "añade micro-interacciones", "agrégale motion", o cuando el usuario pegue código de un AI builder y pida mejorarlo visualmente. No rompe el diseño existente — trabaja con él, no contra él. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:skill-router
commands.description: Meta-skill de navegación del skill set de Leo. Úsala cuando la tarea sea ambigua, compleja, o cruce múltiples dominios y no sea obvio qué skill aplicar. También activa cuando el usuario pregunte explícitamente "¿qué skill uso?", "¿cuál skill aplica aquí?", "ayúdame a elegir la skill correcta", o diga "/route", "/skills", "¿qué skills tengo?". NO reemplaza a las skills individuales — cuando la tarea es clara y una skill encaja directamente (ej: el usuario pide "haz un frontend bonito" → ultimate-frontend activa sola), no uses esta. Esta skill es para cuando hay ambigüedad real: tareas que podrían ir por varios caminos, combinaciones de skills, o cuando el usuario no sabe qué tiene disponible. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:stem-tutor-es
commands.description: Use this skill whenever Leonardo asks to understand, explain, or work through any STEM concept, paper, exercise, or study material — always in Spanish. Triggers include: "explícame X", "no entiendo este paper", "qué significa Y en este contexto", "resuelve este ejercicio", "cómo funciona Z", "cuál es la intuición de...", "demuestra que...", "qué diferencia hay entre A y B", questions while following the AIMaster study plan, or any request to read and explain a technical paper or book chapter. Covers all STEM areas: deep learning, ML clásico, matemáticas, bioinformática, neurociencia computacional, física, química, visión computacional, NLP, teoría de la información, lenguajes de programación (Python, C++, etc.), y más. Use this skill any time Leo is learning, not just coding — if he's trying to understand something, this skill applies. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:the-council
commands.description: Multi-perspective collaborative analysis and planning. Use when the user asks to "consult the council", "get multiple perspectives", "attack this from different angles", "qué diría el consejo", or explicitly wants more than one analytical lens before making a decision or implementation plan. Also use when the problem is complex enough that a single perspective would miss important tradeoffs (architecture decisions, research strategy, debugging a hard problem, major design choices). No external APIs or API keys required — runs entirely within Claude by activating distinct analytical personas that each have different priorities and blind spots. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:ultimate-frontend
commands.description: La skill definitiva para crear interfaces frontend hermosas, producción-grade, y técnicamente sólidas. Úsala cuando el usuario pida construir, rediseñar, auditar, pulir, animar, o mejorar cualquier interfaz web o móvil — páginas, componentes, dashboards, landing pages, apps, formularios, sistemas de diseño, o cualquier elemento visual interactivo. También activa cuando el usuario mencione palabras como "bonito", "hermoso", "diseño", "UI", "frontend", "componente", "landing", "dashboard", "animación", "tipografía", "colores", "modo oscuro", "responsive", "Tailwind", "React", "Next.js", "Vue", "Svelte", "HTML/CSS", o cualquier framework de frontend — aunque no pidan explícitamente "diseño". Si el resultado cambiará cómo algo se ve, siente, mueve, o interactúa, usa esta skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)
